svg.title: Measured ULMDB SQL throughput including slower small-record workloads

cc:Work.dc:title: Measured ULMDB SQL throughput including slower small-record workloads
cc:Work.dc:description: Separate matched SQLite small and larger-record profiles, and an unchanged PostgreSQL reference. Native tables equal one. Experimental external storage has different concurrency and recovery guarantees.

g.text: Median throughput relative to native SQL tables · higher is faster · 1× = native

g.text: Same SQL, keys, bytes and validation in each pair. Commits included: SQLite WAL/FULL; PostgreSQL fsync + synchronous_commit.

g.text: Warm random reads · IN groups of 100 · 1,000 rows/commit · single client · dots show individual paired trials.
